graph.num_vertices: <int> Total number of vertices in the graph available for inclusion in the clique.
graph.num_edges: <int> Total number of edges in the graph.
graph.vertices: <list[int], length num_vertices> Identifiers of all vertices in the graph.
graph.edges: <list[list[int]], shape [num_edges][3]> Each entry is a triple [u, v, weight] giving an undirected edge between two vertices together with the positive weight earned when both endpoints are selected.
